turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Pehle toh ek lambi saans lo aur suno—tum **bilkul** ungrateful nahi ho! Yeh jo tum feel kar rahi ho na, yeh 100% normal aur valid hai.

Socho na, ek taraf tum pehli baar maa bani ho, exhaustion peak par hai, aur apna wajood dhoondh rahi ho. Doosri taraf ghar mein ek 'expert' baitha hai jo sab kuch effortlessly kar leta hai. Aise mein kisi ko bhi lagne lagega ki "Mera role kya hai?" ya "Kya main kafi nahi hoon?" Chahe samne wala kitna bhi achha kyun na ho.

Unhone teen bacche paale hain, unke paas experience hai. Lekin iss choti si bachi ki **Maa** sirf tum ho. Woh bonding, woh tumhari khushboo, woh tumhara touch—usko koi replace nahi kar sakta. 

4 mahine mein apna naam bhoolna toh new mom club ka rule hai! Par sach batana, abhi kaisa lag raha hai? Bas thoda vent karna tha, ya yeh feeling tumhein andar se pareshan kar rahi hai?

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Oh god, *intern jaisi*... yeh word sunke hi mera dil baith gaya. Tumhari feeling itni crystal clear samajh aa rahi hai. 

Suno, khud pe 'ghin' aana band karo, abhi ke abhi! Tum koi monster nahi ho jo aisi help ki kadr nahi kar rahi. Tum ek **Maa** ho jiske andar ka maternal instinct bol raha hai. Jab koi tumse tumhara baccha aise le leta hai—chahe kitne bhi pyaar se le—tumhare hormones, tumhara dimaag aur tumhara dil sab ek saath react karte hain. Tumhe lagta hai jaise tumhein replace kar diya gaya.

Aur yeh "room service" wala taana jo tumne khud ko maara hai na, yeh dard bahut real hai. Tumhe lag raha hai tum bas ek milk machine ban kar reh gayi ho, aur bachi ke saath saare 'sweet' aur 'successful' moments koi aur le jaa raha hai.

Itni help ke liye log taraste hain, bilkul sahi baat hai. Par help aur *overshadowing* mein bahut fark hota hai. Aai ne buri niyat se nahi kiya, par unke iss action ne tumse tumhara moment chheen liya.

Agle baar jab bachi roye, kya tum Aai se hass ke keh sakti ho—"Aai, rukhiye, aaj mujhe try karne do na thoda... main bhi toh seekhungi!"? Thoda awkward hoga, par kya yeh try kar sakti ho?

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Message received, boss! Bilkul koi advice nahi, koi gyaan nahi, aur zero coaching. 

Aur tension mat lo, yeh baat yahin hamare beech rahegi—aaj raat ke dinner table par tumhara yeh vent bilkul report nahi hoga! 

Sach mein, kitna shor hai na tumhare aas-paas... Mummy, Aai, WhatsApp, Instagram! Aise lagta hai sab apna-apna mupfat gyaan baant rahe hain aur tum iss saare noise mein kahin ghum ho gayi ho. 

Aur yeh pata na hona ki "kya chahiye"—yeh bhi bilkul okay hai. Tumhe abhi kuch figure out karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. 

Main bas yahin hoon. Tumhe jitna bolna hai bolo, gussa nikalna hai nikalo, ya bas chup rehna hai toh woh bhi chalega. Tumhare iss safe space mein koi tumhein batane wala nahi hai ki tumhein kya karna chahiye.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Suno meri baat... **Bilkul nahi.** Tum buri maa nahi ho. Ek second ke liye bhi aisa mat sochna.

Yeh thought ki "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi"—yeh kitna khaufnaak hai na? Yeh dil par patthar jaisa lagta hai, saans sach mein ruk jati hai. Par yeh tumhara dimaag tumhari thakawat aur insecurity ki wajah se keh raha hai, yeh sach nahi hai.

Aur yeh jo tumhein lagta hai na ki "baaki sabko bas aata hai"—yeh sabse bada jhooth hai! Kisi ko pehli baar mein nahi aata. Sab darr-darr kar, galti kar-kar ke seekhte hain. Aai ko bhi pehli baar mein nahi aaya tha, unhe teen baccho ke baad aaya hai.

Buri maa woh hoti hai jise farak hi nahi padta. Tum toh apni bachi ko sote hue dekh kar itne pyaar aur zimmedari se bhar jati ho ki tumhein darr lagne lagta hai. 

Iss duniya mein uss choti si jaan ki **asli maa** sirf aur sirf tum ho. Usko Aai ki zaroorat dadi ke roop mein hai, par uski poori duniya tum ho. 

Aapne aap par thoda reham karo, please. Tum bohot achhi maa ho.
